fnol_text: My name is Kofi Haddad and I live at 833 Thornbury Lane, Greenville, SC 29642. You can reach me on (555) 913-3676 or kofi.haddad@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 6 March 2025 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2023-00114. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Haddad on (555) 913-3676 to acknowledge the claim. Kofi confirmed the loss date as 6 March 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Felix Rasmussen gave a statement by phone.
Kofi sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
